alignment_reasoning: The image is classified correctly as a 'comic book' by the fine-grained classifier (Top-1). However, it fails key 'Functional' checkpoints: no sequential panels, no clear speech bubbles/caption boxes, and the title typography is gibberish. Score reflects partial conformance (visual style) but functional failure (narrative structure/text).
